answer: The anchor of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, converted to a slow vesting stream. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The jetty is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the beacon.
